_comment: Creative harness v2 (Fix A): hand-written, schema-VALID forged exemplar cards spanning the archetype families in archetypes.json. Three are drawn per card brief (by archetype + rarity, seeded, never the same three twice in a class) to replace the v1 Strike/Defend/Bash exemplars. `needs` marks class-kind-only exemplars - orb / status / summon (the blueprint's class_kind) or forge / balance (an archetype's mechanic_kind, W0.9) - that are only dealt to a matching class. Coverage contract (tests/test_exemplars.py): every archetype id has >=2 exemplars, every exemplar touches >=1 token of each tagged archetype's ops, and every op / status / when-kind / scale in VOCABULARY.md appears in at least one exemplar. Class-only placeholders: custom status 'Razor Focus', minion 'Bone Thrall', base orbs only (never a custom orb name a dealt class might lack); add_card / transform_card / graft_card targets are OTHER exemplar ids (the same-class rule) - validate with harness_v2.exemplar_validator(), which registers them. Every card here must pass CardValidator under the mod contract. Keep names free of the catalog's metaphor phrases.
